description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterObject, which provides a method to register PHP objects within the Smarty templating engine for use in templates. It includes functionality to validate callable methods and properties, and to store the registered objects.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterObject
classes.description: Class that provides the implementation of registerObject method to register objects for use in Smarty templates.

methods.name: registerObject
methods.description: Registers a PHP object to be used within templates by name, with optional allowed methods and properties, format flags, and block methods. Performs validation on methods and properties, then stores the object in Smarty's registered_objects array.
